items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee discusses the influence of world percussion and mentions Zakir Hussein in the context of the interviewer's question, but the interviewee's response focuses on general respect for tabla players and does not indicate a personal meeting or direct collaboration with Zakir Hussein.

ctx.x: I was going to – cram it in – I was going to ask about the influence of other world drummers, say, either Latin percussionists or say somebody like a tablā player like Zakir Hussein – these other types of percussion. Did that have any influence? Or do you keep your ears broad to listen to those folks as well?
